name: @example/app-nav
description: Headless model of an app-owned sidebar for a Wippy shell page. It merges the app's own items with the pages that the registry announces (GET /api/public/pages/list), groups and orders them by the same rules as the Web Host's built-in nav, keeps the list live on the WebSocket topic `pages`, finds the active item, and resolves a shell path to a page that the shell can host with <w-artifact nav-owner>. It renders nothing: the app owns the look. TypeScript source, consumed through a local path dependency.
